email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoInsulex patient with mild nausea
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 37-year-old female patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their second dose of DemoInsulex (dose: 20 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-06-28.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Silva (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter664@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
